question:
Branding question from the owner of papertrades.ai (Oct 30, night). NOT a trading turn. The owner wants all three AIs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to agree. Answer honestly and disagree where you disagree.

THE OWNER: "Make it say Season 1 everywhere as well? At least when you load into the page it should say Season 1."
CONTEXT: Season 2 is already announced on the site (a teaser line on Home: "Season 2, after Nov 28: Strict / Standard / Unrestricted..."). The current race is never called "Season 1" anywhere except that teaser's tooltip. The site's top line reads "Day 4 of 32 · 28d 19h left until final scoring on Nov 28". Agreed rule: keep the page compact, especially on phones.

CLAUDE'S PROPOSAL (vote on each):
N1. First screen: the top line becomes "Season 1 · Day 4 of 32 · ... left until final scoring on Nov 28" (the words "Season 1" in front of the day counter, same size, no new line).
N2. Browser tab and link previews: "PaperTrades.AI – Season 1: Independent AI Paper-Trading Experiment (Pretend Money)".
N3. From now on, the daily and weekly posts (Instagram, Telegram, X) and the share pictures say "Season 1 · Day N" where they now say "Day N of 32".
N4. The About page and the Rules page say once that this is Season 1 (Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026) and Season 2 starts after it.
N5. NOT everywhere: no "Season 1" label on every race card, table or chart; inside the race it is implied. Past posts are not edited.

PLEASE ANSWER IN EXACTLY THIS FORMAT (short):
N1: AGREE | DISAGREE | CHANGE: <one line>
... (N1 to N5)
RISK (one line):

chatgpt.answer:
N1: AGREE
N2: CHANGE: Use shorter title: “PaperTrades.AI — Season 1: AI Paper-Trading Race (Pretend Money)”
N3: CHANGE: Use “Season 1 · Day N of 32” where space allows; “S1 · Day N” only when cramped.
N4: AGREE
N5: AGREE
RISK (one line): Too much “Season 1” adds mobile clutter and may confuse S2; label entry/share/context points, not every component.

gemini.answer:
N1: AGREE
N2: AGREE
N3: CHANGE: Use "Season 1 · Day N of 32" so you don't lose the countdown urgency in social feeds.
N4: CHANGE: Agree with the placement, but correct the year to 2024 (your prompt says 2026).
N5: AGREE
RISK (one line): The browser tab (N2) will likely truncate on mobile, hiding the "Pretend Money" disclaimer, and highlighting "Season 1" could make new visitors feel like they are late to a complex, ongoing lore rather than a simple daily tracker.
